input.message:
The app shell, UI kit, Login, Nexus, Usage, command palette and the full Admin console are built. `npx tsc -b --noEmit` and `npx vite build` both pass on the whole web package, including the workspace agent's files at the time I checked. I checked it visually against a mock API, with headless Chromium screenshots. There are no git commits.

**Things the coordinator needs to know**
- **I changed `web/tsconfig.json`.** TS 7 rejects `baseUrl`, so it now has no `baseUrl` and `"paths": {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}`. Without this, tsc would not run at all.
- **I changed `web/tailwind.config.js`.** Every color class name is the same as before. The colors now use `rgb(var(--x-rgb) / <alpha-value>)`, so opacity modifiers like `bg-pink/10` work. The `--pink` etc. hex vars still exist alongside the new `--pink-rgb` vars.
- **No new dependencies.**
- **The workspace screen exists, so I made no placeholder.** `/p/:slug/*` lazy-loads it and clicking a node lands on it. The workspace agent built its own `features/workspace/ui.tsx` and imports nothing from `@/components/ui` yet.
- `tsc -b` writes a `web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` file. I deleted it; you may want to add it to `.gitignore`.

**Files** (all under `web/src`)
- `main.tsx` (local @fontsource imports, no external requests), `App.tsx` (router, auth guards, global palette/modal/toaster).
- `styles/theme.css` (palette vars) and `styles/index.css` (base, scrollbar, selection, focus rings, reduced motion, and the `nx-glass`, `nx-panel`, `nx-label`, `nx-table`, `nx-scanlines`, `nx-grid`, `nx-vignette`, `nx-gradient-text`, `nx-skeleton` classes).
- `components/ui/*` with an `index.ts` barrel, plus `components/ProjectIcon.tsx`.
- `app/`: AppShell and TopBar, BootScreen, CommandPalette, UserMenu, NotFound.
- `features/auth/LoginPage.tsx`; `features/nexus/` (`engine.ts`, `NexusPage.tsx`, `NewProjectModal.tsx`); `features/usage/` (`UsageMeter.tsx`, `UsagePage.tsx`).
- `features/admin/`: `api.ts`, `common.tsx`, `charts.tsx`, `AdminRoutes.tsx`, and one file per section.
- `lib/format.ts`; `stores/projects.ts`, `stores/ui.ts`, `stores/usage.ts`.

**UI kit** (`import { … } from '@/components/ui'`; props are documented in each file's header)
- **Buttons:** `Button` (variant primary/secondary/ghost/outline/danger, size xs–lg, icon, iconRight, loading, block). `IconButton` (icon, label, size, variant, active, shortcut, tooltipSide; has a built-in tooltip).
- **Form controls:** `Input` (label, hint, error, icon, rightSlot, inputSize, mono). `Textarea` (autosize, maxRows). `Field`. `Select` (options, value, `onChange(value)`, label). `Switch`, `Checkbox`.
- **Overlays:** `Modal` (open, onClose, title, description, footer, size sm–xl). `Drawer`. `Tooltip` (content, side, shortcut). `Popover` (trigger, children as a node or `(close) => node`, side, align). `Menu`.
- **Toasts:** `toast()` with `.success/.error/.warn/.info` and options `{description, duration, action}`; mount `Toaster` once (App already does).
- **Display:** `Tabs` (items, value, onChange, variant underline/pill), `Badge` (tone neutral/pink/warm/violet/ok/warn/bad, dot, mono), `Spinner`, `EmptyState`, `Kbd`, `modKey`, `Avatar`, `StatusDot`, `Skeleton`, `Logo`, `LogoGlyph`, `cn`.
- **Also reusable:** `ProjectBadge`, `ProjectIcon`, `PROJECT_ICONS` and `PROJECT_COLORS` from `@/components/ProjectIcon`. For the workspace's own top bar: `UsageMeter` (`@/features/usage/UsageMeter`), `UserMenu` (`@/app/UserMenu`), and `ConnectionDot` and `PaletteButton` (`@/app/AppShell`). The command palette opens with `useUI.getState().setPalette(true)`; the new-project modal opens with `useUI.getState().setNewProject(true)`.

**Routes**
- `/login` (signed-out users only; honours `?next=`).
- `/` (Nexus), `/usage`, `/admin/*` (admins only; others see a 403).
- `/admin` sub-pages: `live`, `prompts`, `users`, `projects`, `traffic`, `security`, `settings`.
- `/p/:slug/*` (workspace, without my shell).
- `*` shows NotFound. ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens the palette anywhere once signed in.

**Nexus behaviour worth knowing**
- Nodes sit on rings by recency; the ones you drag stay pinned, saved in localStorage under `nx.nexus.pos.v1`. There is a reset-layout button.
- On mount it subscribes to every project in the graph; `graph_pulse` triggers pulse bursts and `run_status` updates node state.
- It pauses when the tab is hidden and goes static under reduced motion. Dense or zoomed-out views use a simplified drawing mode.
- Frame rate in software-rendered headless Chromium: 56 fps with 16 projects, about 29 fps with 150 projects and ~450 strands. A real GPU browser should do better; I haven't measured that.
- Keys: L (list), N (new project), 0 (recenter), +/− (zoom).

**API shapes the backend must match.** `features/admin/api.ts` accepts several variants (bare arrays, `{items}`, snake_case), so most fixes would go there.
- **Overview:** `GET /admin/overview` → `{activeUsers, runsToday, tokensToday, costToday, errorRate (0..1), activeRuns, reqPerMin, usersTotal?}`.
- **Timeseries:** `GET /admin/timeseries?metric&range&groupBy` → `{points:[{ts,value}]}`, or `{series:[{key,label,points:[{ts,value}]}]}` when grouped.
- **Users:**
  - `GET/POST /admin/users`.
  - `PATCH /admin/users/:id` with `{name, email, role, disabled, limits:{dailyTokens, models, modes}, password}`. Password reset goes through this PATCH with `{password}`.
  - `DELETE /admin/users/:id`.
  - `GET/PUT /admin/users/:id/projects` with `{grants:[{projectId, role}]}`.
- **Projects:** `GET /admin/projects` → projects with `members:[{userId,email,name,role}]` and optional `runs`/`tokens`. It falls back to `/projects`. Member edits use `GET/PUT /projects/:id/members` with `{members:[{userId, role}]}`. Archiving uses `PATCH /projects/:id {archived}`.
- **Prompts:** `GET /admin/prompts?userId&projectId&q&cursor&limit` → `{items:[{id, createdAt, userId, userEmail, projectId, projectName, projectSlug, content, attachments[], ip, run:{status, model, mode, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheRead, cacheWrite, costUsd, durationMs}, response}], nextCursor}`.
- **Live runs:** `GET /admin/runs/active` → `[{id, status, userEmail, projectName, projectSlug, model, mode, startedAt, inputTokens, outputTokens, ip}]`. Abort calls `POST /admin/runs/:id/abort` and falls back to `/runs/:id/abort`.
- **Traffic:** `GET /admin/traffic?range` → `{topIps:[{ip, count, userEmail?, lastSeen?}], byStatus:[{status, count}], topPaths:[{path, count, avgMs}], perMinute:[{ts, count}], recent:[{ts, ip, userEmail, method, path, status, ms}]}`. The Live page's request feed uses `recent`.
- **IP rules:** `GET /admin/ip-rules` → `{rules:[{id, cidr, kind:'allow'|'block', note, createdAt}], clientIp}`. `clientIp` is needed for the self-lockout warning. `POST` with `{cidr, kind, note}`; `DELETE /admin/ip-rules/:id`.
- **Audit:** `GET /admin/activity?action&cursor&limit` → `{items:[{id, ts, userEmail, ip, action, target, meta}], nextCursor}`. The failed sign-ins panel queries `action=login_failed`.
- **Settings:** `GET /admin/settings` → `{models, defaultModel, globalDailyTokenCap, claudeAuth:{set, masked, kind, updatedAt}}`. `PUT /admin/settings` takes a partial object; `claudeAuthToken` is write-only, and an empty string clears it.
- **Non-admin endpoints:**
  - `POST /auth/password {currentPassword, newPassword}`.
  - `POST /projects {name, description, color, icon, slug}` → a project (or `{project}`).
  - `/projects` may return an array or `{projects}`.
